title: Gremlib
description: A versatile 26.1+ library made to help with multiloader unification and common functions.
body:
# Gremlib
Gremlib is a versatile library for 26.1 and newer. Made with the intent to power various mods by GremStudio and Siuolplex and act as a multiloader bridge similar to Architectury.

The library currently or plans to feature support for unified loader initialization, world interaction events, public constructors for common blocks, and more!
